Rule 16's limit with rule 30: the ASV writes an appositional even before a phrase no object marker stands on, and this verse contains no marker at all. Every morpheme in the phrase already has its own English — el has to, bet has the house, yisrael has of Israel — so no morpheme licenses even, and rule 42's surplus-and reasoning forbids folding it into the preposition, which is written beside that rendering rather than inside it.
